subject: Fail CONFIG REWRITE when the old config file reads short (#5158)
reason: The change only alters behaviour when fread of the old config file returns fewer bytes than fstat reported (src/config.c rewriteConfigReadOldFile): previously a partial read proceeded with an uninitialized SDS_NOINIT buffer tail, now CONFIG REWRITE fails with errno set to EIO on a quiet short read. That condition needs a file whose stat size exceeds its readable bytes - a sysfs/procfs special file (Valkey's own tcl test symlinks the config to /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled) or an external truncation racing the single-threaded fstat+fread.
